Ellen (Head of Eng): Thanks for the great Q&A today. Dropping an open follow-up thread for release cadence, oncall experiments, quality gates, and SLA clarifications. Keep replies short so we can action quickly.

Mikko (VP Eng): Short summary: aim for predictability. Major releases on a ~3-week track; minor/patch windows weekly. Hotfix fast-path still exists (ops sign-off + post-mortem within 3 days).

Jae (Eng Manager): Can we get a one-line "major vs minor" definition for PMs and PR templates? Teams keep debating labels.

Samira (Director of Reliability): Proposal: "Major = API contract change, model weight changes, or DB schema migrations; Minor = config, infra, perf tuning, non-contract adjustments." I'll put examples in the runbook.

Kai (SRE): On oncall cadence: many teams requested shorter primes. Ops suggests 2w primary + 72h (3d) overlap where outgoing is available for context but not first pager. Slightly shorter overlap to reduce stacked work. We'll pilot 2 teams.

Jae (Eng Manager): 3d overlap seems reasonable. Which teams should pilot?

Mikko (VP Eng): Recommend runtime and api-platform for pilot; both have mature runbooks and frequent deploys. Pilot length = 8 weeks, measure pages during overlap, ack latency, and handover questions.

Samira (Director of Reliability): Quality gates: product asked for quieter alerts. New starting thresholds (configurable per model family): block if golden-set relevance drops >3% relative OR hallucination rate increases >7% absolute OR 95p latency regresses >12%. Lower-severity warnings at half those numbers.

Ellen (Head of Eng): These thresholds are slightly different from the draft discussed earlier; can we tie them to traffic tiers? e.g., high-volume models get stricter latency numbers.

Samira (Director of Reliability): Yes, we'll tier thresholds: Tier A (high traffic): 95p latency block >8% reg; Tier B: >12%. Will publish a mapping in the PR.

Kai (SRE): Escalation timeline for blocked releases: acknowledge within 4 business hours; initial mitigation plan within 24 hours; if unresolved after 36 hours escalate to release lead + product + reliability. Execs only after 72 hours or material customer impact.

ops-bot: Heads-up: new oncall-overlap template published at https://redwood.internal/playbooks/oncall-overlap (bot)

Jae (Eng Manager): Action items: @Kai to open PR with pilot schedule + 72h overlap template by EOW; @Samira to publish tiered thresholds + example mappings; @Mikko to add a one-liner for major/minor into PR templates. I'll add a release-ready checklist snippet to team PR templates (CI, smoke, rollback test, docs note).

Mikko (VP Eng): Also drop any tricky cases (multi-service migrations, backfill jobs, model-only weight swaps) in this thread so we can add explicit rules.

Ellen (Head of Eng): Thanks all. I'll stitch a one-page summary after PRs land and we can share with PMs. :thumbsup:
